  resolution_tier?: string;
  upload_id?: string;
  created_at?: string;
  id?: string;
  status?: string;
  max_stored_resolution?: string;
  passthrough?: string;
  encoding_tier?: string;
  video_quality?: string;
  master_access?: string;
  aspect_ratio?: string;
  duration?: number;
  max_stored_frame_rate?: number;
  mp4_support?: string;
  max_resolution_tier?: string;
  tracks?: Array<
    {
      _key: string;
    } & MuxTrack
  >;
  playback_ids?: Array<
    {
      _key: string;
    } & MuxPlaybackId
  >;
  static_renditions?: MuxStaticRenditions;
  master?: MuxMasterFile;
};

  >;

export type Faq = {
  _id: string;
  _type: "faq";
  _createdAt: string;
  _updatedAt: string;
  _rev: string;
  language?: string;
  title: string;
  richText?: Array<{
    children?: Array<{
      marks?: Array<string>;
      text?: string;
      _type: "span";
      _key: string;
    }>;
    style?: "normal" | "h2" | "h3" | "h4" | "h5" | "h6" | "inline";
    listItem?: "number" | "bullet";
    markDefs?: Array<{
      customLink?: CustomUrl;
      _type: "customLink";
      _key: string;
    }>;
    level?: number;
    _type: "block";
    _key: string;
  }>;
};

  seoImage?: {
    asset?: SanityImageAssetReference;

    hotspot?: SanityImageHotspot;
    crop?: SanityImageCrop;
    _type: "image";
  };
  seoNoIndex?: boolean;
  ogTitle?: string;
  ogDescription?: string;
};

    cells[]{\n          ...,\n          value[]{\n            ...,\n            _type == "block" => {\n              ...,\n              \n  markDefs[]{\n    ...,\n    \n  ...customLink{\n    openInNewTab,\n    "href": select(\n      type == "internal" => select(\n  internal->site != $site => null,\n  internal->language == $defaultLocale => internal->slug.current,\n  internal->slug.current == "/" => "/" + internal->language,\n  "/" + internal->language + internal->slug.current\n),\n      type == "external" => external,\n      "#"\n    ),\n  }\n\n  }\n\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  }\n,\n    \n  _type == "videoFeature" => {\n    ...,\n    \n  richText[]{\n    ...,\n    _type == "block" => {\n      ...,\n      \n  markDefs[]{\n    ...,\n    \n  ...customLink{\n    openInNewTab,\n    "href": select(\n      type == "internal" => select(\n  internal->site != $site => null,\n  internal->language == $defaultLocale => internal->slug.current,\n  internal->slug.current == "/" => "/" + internal->language,\n  "/" + internal->language + internal->slug.current\n),\n      type == "external" => external,\n      "#"\n    ),\n  }\n\n  }\n\n    },\n    _type == "image" => {\n      \n  "id": asset._ref,\n  "preview": asset->metadata.lqip,\n  "alt": coalesce(alt, asset->altText, caption),\n  hotspot {\n    x,\n    y\n  },\n  crop {\n    bottom,\n    left,\n    right,\n    top\n  }\n,\n      "caption": caption\n    },\n    _type == "table" => {\n      ...,\n      rows[]{\n        ...,\n        cells[]{\n          ...,\n          value[]{\n            ...,\n            _type == "block" => {\n              ...,\n              \n  markDefs[]{\n    ...,\n    \n  ...customLink{\n    openInNewTab,\n    "href": select(\n      type == "internal" => select(\n  internal->site != $site => null,\n  internal->language == $defaultLocale => internal->slug.current,\n  internal->slug.current == "/" => "/" + internal->language,\n  "/" + internal->language + internal->slug.current\n),\n      type == "external" => external,\n      "#"\n    ),\n  }\n\n  }\n\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n,\n    video {\n      \n  asset {\n    \n  "playbackId": asset->playbackId,\n  "policy": asset->data.playback_ids[0].policy,\n  "aspectRatio": asset->data.aspect_ratio,\n  "status": asset->status,\n  "thumbTime": asset->thumbTime,\n  "title": asset->filename\n\n  },\n  autoPlay,\n  loop\n\n    },\n  }\n\n  }\n,\n    \n  "translations": *[_type == "translation.metadata" && references(^._id)][0]\n    .translations[defined(value)]{\n      language,\n      "site": value->site,\n      "slug": value->slug.current\n    }\n\n  }\n': PageQueryResult;
    '\n  *[_type == "page" && site == $site && language == $locale && slug.current == $path][0]{\n    _id,\n    _type,\n    site,\n    language,\n    title,\n    description,\n    "slug": slug.current,\n    \n  seoTitle,\n  seoDescription,\n  seoNoIndex,\n  ogTitle,\n  ogDescription,\n  "ogImage": select(\n    defined(seoImage.asset->url) => seoImage,\n    defined(image.asset->url) => image,\n    null\n  ){\n    \n  "id": asset._ref,\n  "preview": asset->metadata.lqip,\n  "alt": coalesce(alt, asset->altText, caption),\n  hotspot {\n    x,\n    y\n  },\n  crop {\n    bottom,\n    left,\n    right,\n    top\n  }\n\n  }\n,\n    \n  "translations": *[_type == "translation.metadata" && references(^._id)][0]\n    .translations[defined(value)]{\n      language,\n      "site": value->site,\n      "slug": value->slug.current\n    }\n\n  }\n': PageMetadataQueryResult;
    '\n  *[_type == "page" && defined(site) && defined(language) && defined(slug.current)]{\n    site,\n    language,\n    "slug": slug.current\n  }\n': PagePathsQueryResult;
    '\n  *[_type == "page" && site == $site && defined(slug.current) && seoNoIndex != true]{\n    language,\n    "slug": slug.current,\n    "lastModified": _updatedAt,\n    \n  "translations": *[_type == "translation.metadata" && references(^._id)][0]\n    .translations[defined(value)]{\n      language,\n      "site": value->site,\n      "slug": value->slug.current\n    }\n\n  }\n': SitemapQueryResult;
    '\n  *[_type == "navigation" && _id == $id && site == $site && language == $locale][0]{\n    _id,\n    columns[]{\n      _key,\n      _type == "navigationColumn" => {\n        "type": "column",\n        title,\n        links[]{\n          _key,\n          name,\n          icon,\n          description,\n          \n  "openInNewTab": url.openInNewTab,\n  "href": select(\n    url.type == "internal" => select(\n  url.internal->site != $site => null,\n  url.internal->language == $defaultLocale => url.internal->slug.current,\n  url.internal->slug.current == "/" => "/" + url.internal->language,\n  "/" + url.internal->language + url.internal->slug.current\n),\n    url.type == "external" => url.external,\n    url.href\n  )\n\n        }\n      },\n      _type == "navigationLink" => {\n        "type": "link",\n        name,\n        \n  "openInNewTab": url.openInNewTab,\n  "href": select(\n    url.type == "internal" => select(\n  url.internal->site != $site => null,\n  url.internal->language == $defaultLocale => url.internal->slug.current,\n  url.internal->slug.current == "/" => "/" + url.internal->language,\n  "/" + url.internal->language + url.internal->slug.current\n),\n    url.type == "external" => url.external,\n    url.href\n  )\n\n      }\n    },\n    \n  buttons[]{\n    text,\n    variant,\n    _key,\n    _type,\n    \n  "openInNewTab": url.openInNewTab,\n  "href": select(\n    url.type == "internal" => select(\n  url.internal->site != $site => null,\n  url.internal->language == $defaultLocale => url.internal->slug.current,\n  url.internal->slug.current == "/" => "/" + url.internal->language,\n  "/" + url.internal->language + url.internal->slug.current\n),\n    url.type == "external" => url.external,\n    url.href\n  )\n\n  }\n\n  }\n': NavigationQueryResult;
    '\n  *[_type == "footer" && _id == $id && site == $site && language == $locale][0]{\n    _id,\n    subtitle,\n    columns[]{\n      _key,\n      title,\n      links[]{\n        _key,\n        name,\n        \n  "openInNewTab": url.openInNewTab,\n  "href": select(\n    url.type == "internal" => select(\n  url.internal->site != $site => null,\n  url.internal->language == $defaultLocale => url.internal->slug.current,\n  url.internal->slug.current == "/" => "/" + url.internal->language,\n  "/" + url.internal->language + url.internal->slug.current\n),\n    url.type == "external" => url.external,\n    url.href\n  )\n\n      }\n    },\n    copyright,\n    credits[]{\n      _key,\n      label,\n      url,\n      logo {\n        \n  "id": asset._ref,\n  "preview": asset->metadata.lqip,\n  "alt": coalesce(alt, asset->altText, caption),\n  hotspot {\n    x,\n    y\n  },\n  crop {\n    bottom,\n    left,\n    right,\n    top\n  }\n\n      }\n    }\n  }\n': FooterQueryResult;
    '\n  *[_type == "settings" && _id == $id && site == $site][0]{\n    _id,\n    _type,\n    site,\n    "siteTitle": coalesce(\n  siteTitle[language == $locale][0].value,\n  siteTitle[language == $defaultLocale][0].value\n),\n    "siteDescription": coalesce(\n  siteDescription[language == $locale][0].value,\n  siteDescription[language == $defaultLocale][0].value\n),\n    logos {\n      logo {\n        \n  "id": asset._ref,\n  "preview": asset->metadata.lqip,\n  "alt": coalesce(alt, asset->altText, caption),\n  hotspot {\n    x,\n    y\n  },\n  crop {\n    bottom,\n    left,\n    right,\n    top\n  }\n\n      },\n      logoDark {\n        \n  "id": asset._ref,\n  "preview": asset->metadata.lqip,\n  "alt": coalesce(alt, asset->altText, caption),\n  hotspot {\n    x,\n    y\n  },\n  crop {\n    bottom,\n    left,\n    right,\n    top\n  }\n\n      },\n      footerLogo {\n        \n  "id": asset._ref,\n  "preview": asset->metadata.lqip,\n  "alt": coalesce(alt, asset->altText, caption),\n  hotspot {\n    x,\n    y\n  },\n  crop {\n    bottom,\n    left,\n    right,\n    top\n  }\n\n      }\n    },\n    favicon {\n      "svg": svg.asset->url,\n      "ico": ico.asset->url\n    },\n    ogImage {\n      \n  "id": asset._ref,\n  "preview": asset->metadata.lqip,\n  "alt": coalesce(alt, asset->altText, caption),\n  hotspot {\n    x,\n    y\n  },\n  crop {\n    bottom,\n    left,\n    right,\n    top\n  }\n\n    },\n    contactEmail,\n    socialLinks {\n      linkedin,\n      facebook,\n      twitter,\n      instagram,\n      youtube,\n      reddit\n    }\n  }\n': SettingsQueryResult;
    '\n  *[_type == "redirect" && status == "active" && defined(site) && defined(source.current) && defined(destination.current)]{\n    site,\n    "source": source.current,\n    "destination": destination.current,\n    "permanent": permanent == "true"\n  }\n': RedirectsQueryResult;
  }
}

  interface SanityQueries extends globalThis.SanityQueries {}
